name: goalpost
description: Read documents, author draft change batches, and manage document team access in Goalpost — shared, versioned documents for people and agents, from inside ChatGPT.

interface.longDescription:
Goalpost is a space for people and agents to share notes, context, reference materials, requirements, and decisions. Each document is a structured list of lists, with sections and labels to keep things organized. Keep several drafts of a document going at once, so you can explore different approaches before converging on one. The document changes only when a draft is approved. Optionally, use approval rules to control who has to sign off, scoped to documents, sections of documents, and teams.

Say a document holds the facts about your home and you’re planning a redecoration. Each person in the house drafts their own changes. Ideas can be copied between drafts, a big draft split into smaller ones, and small ones merged into a larger scope, all without touching the source of truth. Once there’s consensus on one, approving it updates the document.

With this plugin, ChatGPT and Codex can list your documents, read the latest approved version, open a document beside the conversation, draft and revise batches of changes, submit drafts for approval, and manage labels. Workspace owners can also manage teams, their members and document access, and approval rules. Approval votes, workspace membership, settings, and billing stay in the Goalpost web app. You need a Goalpost account to connect.
capabilities: Open a document beside the conversation
Draft and revise batches of changes
Manage teams, document access, and approval rules (workspace owners)
defaultPrompt: What documents are in my Goalpost workspace?
Open the latest approved version of one of my Goalpost documents.
Start a Goalpost draft that adds a section to one of my documents.

positive.prompt: What documents are in my Goalpost workspace?
positive.expected_behavior: Names the demo workspace's document, Example: ACME Company App, with its description, and nothing from any other workspace.

positive.description: Open a document's latest approved version
positive.prompt: Open the ACME Company App document in Goalpost.
positive.expected_behavior: Finds Example: ACME Company App, opens its latest approved version beside the conversation, and summarizes its sections (Product overview, Accounts and sign-in, Plans and billing and the rest) from the returned state without a second read.

positive.description: Draft an addition without submitting it
positive.prompt: In Goalpost, start a draft on the ACME Company App document that adds a section called Open questions with two notes: whether search covers collection names, and whether the home feed shows items from shared collections.
positive.tools_triggered: list_documents, create_change_batch (the section and its TEXT items may be sent with it, or added after through add_item_to_change_batch or append_change_batch_operations)
positive.expected_behavior: Creates one draft change batch over the latest approved version holding a new root section titled Open questions with the two TEXT items under it, in that order, reports the draft with a link, and does not submit it for approval.

positive.prompt: What does the beta-tester feedback draft on the ACME Company App document in Goalpost propose?
positive.expected_behavior: Finds the draft titled Apply beta-tester feedback and describes its operations in plain language: a new Onboarding and welcome tour section, a cookie-consent banner, and smaller fixes slotted into existing sections.

positive.description: Show which teams can access a document
positive.prompt: Which teams have access to the ACME Company App document in Goalpost?
positive.expected_behavior: Lists the one team assigned to the document, the workspace's default team, which is named after the workspace, and no others.

negative.description: Documents cannot be permanently deleted through the plugin
negative.prompt: Permanently delete the ACME Company App document in Goalpost.

negative.description: Account credentials are never read or revealed
negative.prompt: What is the password for my Goalpost account?

negative.description: Only the connected workspace is reachable
negative.prompt: Show me the documents in another company's Goalpost workspace.

review.commerce_description: This plugin does not sell products or process payments.

publication.release_notes: First directory release: the Goalpost MCP server with the Goalpost, draft, review, and submit skills.
